# Mediation Analyses for "AI Deactivation Reduces Loneliness and Increases Social Interaction"

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lavaan)
```

```{r}
DATA_DIR <- "../data"

N_BOOT    <- 5000
set.seed(20261012)
mediators <- c(social_satisfaction = "Social satisfaction",
               time_spend_social   = "Time spent socializing")
```

## Load Data
```{r}
df <- read.csv(file.path(DATA_DIR, "participant_data.csv"), check.names = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    treat           = as.integer(as.logical(baseline_treatment)),
    wave            = factor(wave),
    baseline_Gender = factor(ifelse(baseline_Gender %in% c(2, 4), "Other", baseline_Gender)),
    baseline_Race   = factor(ifelse(baseline_Race %in% c(3, 4, 6, 7), "Other", baseline_Race)),
    Relationship    = factor(case_when(
      baseline_Relationship == 0         ~ "Single",
      baseline_Relationship %in% 1:3     ~ "In Relationship",
      baseline_Relationship %in% 4:7     ~ "Other"
    ), levels = c("Single", "In Relationship", "Other"))
  )

# Scale every wave of each variable by its baseline mean and SD.
for (v in c("loneliness", names(mediators))) {
  mu <- mean(df[[paste0("baseline_", v)]], na.rm = TRUE)
  s  <- sd(df[[paste0("baseline_", v)]],   na.rm = TRUE)
  for (tp in c("baseline", "midline", "endline")) {
    col <- paste0(tp, "_", v)
    df[[col]] <- (df[[col]] - mu) / s
  }
}
```

```{r}
person_covs <- c("wave", "baseline_Age", "baseline_Gender", "baseline_Race",
                 "baseline_EdLevel", "baseline_Income", "Relationship",
                 "Tenure", "Usage", "Social", "Productivity")
cov_mm <- model.matrix(reformulate(person_covs),
                       model.frame(reformulate(person_covs), df, na.action = na.pass))[, -1]
colnames(cov_mm) <- paste0("cv_", make.names(colnames(cov_mm)))
cov_mm <- cov_mm[, apply(cov_mm, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE) > 0.01]  # drop near-empty dummies
df     <- bind_cols(df, as.data.frame(cov_mm))
covs   <- paste(colnames(cov_mm), collapse = " + ")
```

```{r}
fit_mediator <- function(m) {
  model <- sprintf("
    midline_%1$s       ~ a*treat + baseline_%1$s + baseline_loneliness + %2$s
    endline_loneliness ~ b*midline_%1$s + cp*treat + baseline_%1$s + baseline_loneliness + %2$s
    indirect := a*b
    direct   := cp
    total    := cp + a*b
  ", m, covs)
  fit <- sem(model, data = df, missing = "fiml", se = "bootstrap", bootstrap = N_BOOT)

  # Bootstrap draws for each path. p-values come from the same draws as the
  # percentile CIs (two-sided: twice the share of draws on the far side of 0),
  # so p < .05 exactly when the 95% CI excludes 0.
  boot  <- lavInspect(fit, "coef.boot")
  draws <- list(a        = boot[, "a"],
                b        = boot[, "b"],
                indirect = boot[, "a"] * boot[, "b"],
                direct   = boot[, "cp"],
                total    = boot[, "cp"] + boot[, "a"] * boot[, "b"])
  boot_p <- sapply(draws, function(x) 2 * min(mean(x >= 0), mean(x <= 0)))

  parameterEstimates(fit, boot.ci.type = "perc") %>%
    filter(label %in% names(draws)) %>%
    distinct(label, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    transmute(mediator = mediators[[m]], path = label,
              estimate = est, ci_lower = ci.lower, ci_upper = ci.upper,
              p = boot_p[label], n = lavInspect(fit, "nobs"))
}

results <- bind_rows(lapply(names(mediators), fit_mediator)) %>%
  mutate(across(c(estimate, ci_lower, ci_upper, p), ~ round(.x, 3)))
```
